title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #17

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which choice is likely to bring a good result? (1 mark)
   A. Doing homework before playing
   B. Telling a lie
   C. Skipping class
   D. Copying from a friend

2. If a child is hurt by someone, whose fault is it? (1 mark)
   A. The person who did wrong
   B. The parents
   C. The school
   D. The child

3. The Bible begins by telling us that God is: (1 mark)
   A. The Creator of heaven and earth
   B. A king of Egypt
   C. A teacher of the law
   D. A farmer

4. How many books are in the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 66
   C. 27
   D. 39

5. Who opened the donkey's mouth? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. The angel of the king
   C. The Lord
   D. Balak

6. What did the donkey see on the road? (1 mark)
   A. A snake
   B. A wall
   C. A lion
   D. The angel of the Lord

7. Who was told by an angel that they would have a son called Samson? (1 mark)
   A. Ruth
   B. His parents
   C. Joshua
   D. Balak

8. Which city did Abram come from? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Ur
   C. Nazareth
   D. Jerusalem

9. Which of these shows obedience like Abraham's? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring instructions
   B. Arguing
   C. Waiting for others
   D. Following good instructions even when it is hard

10. Where did Abram live before going to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Rome
   B. Egypt
   C. Haran
   D. Bethlehem

11. What does the name Jesus mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Lord saves
   B. Great king
   C. Father of many
   D. Gift

12. Which angel appeared to Mary? (1 mark)
   A. Raphael
   B. Gabriel
   C. Michael
   D. Peter

13. Why could Zechariah not speak for a time? (1 mark)
   A. He was ill
   B. He was tired
   C. He was sad
   D. He did not believe the angel's words

14. Where was Zechariah when the angel appeared to him? (1 mark)
   A. In the temple
   B. On a mountain
   C. At home
   D. By the river

15. What is a miracle? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. An amazing act that shows God's power
   C. An ordinary meal
   D. A school lesson

16. Which is a way of thanking God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring Him
   B. Praying and singing praise
   C. Being rude
   D. Complaining

17. How did Jesus feel when He saw the widow? (1 mark)
   A. His heart went out to her
   B. He was bored
   C. He was afraid
   D. He was angry

18. What does the miracle show about Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. He is a king of Rome
   B. He is only a teacher
   C. He is a weak man
   D. He has power over death

19. What should we do when we face problems? (1 mark)
   A. Hide
   B. Pray and ask for help
   C. Blame others
   D. Give up

20. According to the Lord's Prayer, we ask God to forgive us as we: (1 mark)
   A. Forget others
   B. Forgive others
   C. Ignore others
   D. Punish others

21. What does Matthew 5:39 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   B. Ignore everyone
   C. Hit back harder
   D. Take what is yours

22. Which is an example of helping a classmate? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at him
   B. Sharing your pencil
   C. Hiding your pencil
   D. Telling lies

23. Which of these is a physical need? (1 mark)
   A. A loud radio
   B. Food
   C. A game
   D. A toy

24. What does the woman's search teach us about money? (1 mark)
   A. Money is unimportant
   B. Lose it quickly
   C. Hide it always
   D. Money is valuable and should be looked after

25. Where is the parable of the mustard seed found in Luke? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Luke 15:8
   D. Luke 13:18-19

26. What group did Nicodemus belong to? (1 mark)
   A. The Pharisees
   B. The disciples
   C. The shepherds
   D. The Romans

27. Who is a stranger? (1 mark)
   A. Your cousin
   B. Your teacher
   C. Your grandmother
   D. Someone you do not know

28. Which of these is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Saying sorry
   B. Copying in a test
   C. Admitting a mistake
   D. Returning lost money

29. Who ate the fruit God had forbidden? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham and Sarah
   B. Peter and John
   C. Joseph and Mary
   D. Adam and Eve

30. Which is school property? (1 mark)
   A. Your shoes
   B. A desk
   C. A pencil case
   D. Your lunch

31. Which chore shows responsibility at home? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding
   B. Breaking plates
   C. Complaining
   D. Washing plates

32. Why is the church called the house of God? (1 mark)
   A. It is a shop
   B. It is a school
   C. It is a farm
   D. It is a holy place for worship

33. What did Jesus say the temple should be called? (1 mark)
   A. A palace
   B. A house of prayer
   C. A school
   D. A market

34. Who came to Jesus in the temple after the clearing? (1 mark)
   A. The blind and the lame
   B. Kings
   C. Soldiers
   D. Tax collectors

35. What does the word apostle mean? (1 mark)
   A. A fisher
   B. A king
   C. One who is sent
   D. One who sits

36. What does the word Christian mean? (1 mark)
   A. A follower of Christ
   B. A priest
   C. A rich person
   D. A soldier

37. What did Stephen see before he died? (1 mark)
   A. A storm
   B. Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   C. Nothing
   D. A lion

38. Which is a group that a child should not join? (1 mark)
   A. A Bible club
   B. A football team with good rules
   C. A gang that does wrong
   D. A church choir

39. The Lord's Prayer can be grouped into praise, provision, pardon and protection. Which idea is about forgiving and being forgiven? (1 mark)
   A. Protection
   B. Praise
   C. Pardon
   D. Provision

40. How can we grow the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Pray, read the Bible and practise
   B. Only watch TV
   C. Ignore the Bible
   D. Only sleep

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Outline three results of disobedience. (3 marks)

42. Describe how the ten lepers showed faith. (3 marks)

43. State three challenges that children may face and how they can involve God. (3 marks)

44. Explain what the parable of the mustard seed teaches about God's kingdom. (3 marks)

45. Give three ways in which God helps us today. (3 marks)

46. Explain how Proverbs 1:7 helps us to understand why Joseph was so wise. (5 marks)

47. Describe how the early church began. (4 marks)

48. Explain what it means to say that love is a choice. (4 marks)

49. Explain what it means to repent as taught in Acts 2:38 and how a child can do it. (5 marks)

50. In your own words, what is a parable and why did Jesus use them? (2 marks)

51. Explain how a child can show compassion at school and at home, and why prayer is important when facing challenges. (5 marks)

52. Explain the meaning of the word disciple. (2 marks)

53. Explain why Christians should show the fruit of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

54. State two things the angel said about John before he was born. (2 marks)

55. Give two forms of dishonesty other than lying. (2 marks)

56. Explain why sexual purity is important and how children can begin to live a holy life like Mary. (5 marks)

57. Give three examples of how a child can show self-control at school. (3 marks)

58. Explain the meaning of the word "inspired" when we say the Bible is inspired by God. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Doing homework before playing
   Doing your work first helps you learn and stay out of trouble.

2. A — The person who did wrong
   It is never the child's fault.

3. A — The Creator of heaven and earth
   Genesis 1:1 tells us God created heaven and earth.

4. C — 27
   The New Testament has 27 books.

5. C — The Lord
   The Lord made the donkey speak.

6. D — The angel of the Lord
   The angel stood in the road with a drawn sword.

7. B — His parents
   The angel of the Lord appeared to Samson's parents.

8. B — Ur
   Abram was born in Ur of the Chaldeans.

9. D — Following good instructions even when it is hard
   Abraham obeyed God without knowing the whole plan.

10. C — Haran
   Terah's family settled in Haran.

11. A — The Lord saves
   Matthew 1:21 links His name to saving people from their sins.

12. B — Gabriel
   Luke 1:26 says God sent the angel Gabriel.

13. D — He did not believe the angel's words
   Luke 1:20 says he would be silent because he did not believe.

14. A — In the temple
   He was burning incense in the temple.

15. B — An amazing act that shows God's power
   Miracles show God's power.

16. B — Praying and singing praise
   Praise and prayer express thanks.

17. A — His heart went out to her
   Luke 7:13 says He had compassion.

18. D — He has power over death
   Jesus is Lord of life.

19. B — Pray and ask for help
   We can bring our worries to God and to trusted adults.

20. B — Forgive others
   The prayer links our forgiveness with forgiving others.

21. A — Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   Jesus taught us to break the cycle of revenge.

22. B — Sharing your pencil
   Sharing meets a need.

23. B — Food
   Food, water, clothing and shelter are physical needs.

24. D — Money is valuable and should be looked after
   The woman valued her coin.

25. D — Luke 13:18-19
   Luke 13:18-19 contains the parable.

26. A — The Pharisees
   He was a Pharisee.

27. D — Someone you do not know
   A stranger is someone you do not know.

28. B — Copying in a test
   Copying is cheating.

29. D — Adam and Eve
   Genesis 3 tells about Adam and Eve.

30. B — A desk
   A desk belongs to the school.

31. D — Washing plates
   Doing chores shows duty.

32. D — It is a holy place for worship
   Believers meet there to worship God.

33. B — A house of prayer
   Matthew 21:13 says, "My house will be called a house of prayer."

34. A — The blind and the lame
   Matthew 21:14 says He healed them.

35. C — One who is sent
   Apostles were sent out with a message.

36. A — A follower of Christ
   Christian means a follower of Christ.

37. B — Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   Acts 7:55-56.

38. C — A gang that does wrong
   Ungodly groups lead to harm.

39. C — Pardon
   Pardon means forgiveness.

40. A — Pray, read the Bible and practise
   Practice and prayer help.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punishment, danger, loss of trust, guilt, poor marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: They called out to Jesus; they obeyed His command to go to the priests before they were healed; one returned to give thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Illness, loss of a loved one, lack of school fees, bullying, exams. They can pray, trust God and ask trusted adults for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid challenge with a way of involving God, up to 3.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: It began small, with Jesus and a few followers, but it grows large and gives shelter to many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for small beginning, 1 for growth, 1 for shelter or many people.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gives courage, wisdom, the power to forgive, healing and protection, and talents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: The fear of the Lord means respect and love for God. Joseph respected God, trusted Him and obeyed Him. God gave him wisdom, so he could interpret the dream and give good advice. We too should respect God to receive wisdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of the verse, 1 for Joseph respecting God, 1 for God giving wisdom, 1 for the good advice, 1 for application to us.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit came at Pentecost, Peter preached, people asked what to do, Peter told them to repent and be baptised, about three thousand believed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: We do not always feel like loving. We can still choose to be kind, like helping someone who annoyed us. Love shows in actions.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not always feeling, 1 for choosing kindness, 1 for example, 1 for actions.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Repent means to be sorry for sin and turn away from it. Peter told people to repent and be baptised. A child can admit wrong, tell God sorry, ask forgiveness from others, make a decision to do better and ask the Holy Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for Acts 2:38, 1 for admitting, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for deciding to do better.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: A short story used to teach a lesson about God and life. Stories are easy to remember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for story and 1 for teaching a lesson.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: At school: share, comfort a sad classmate, include a lonely child. At home: help with chores, care for a sick family member. Prayer is important because God hears us and helps, and it gives peace and courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for God hearing, 1 for peace or courage, 1 for clear link to compassion.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: A follower and learner of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for follower and 1 for learner.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: It pleases God, makes us like Jesus, and helps us to live well with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: He would bring joy, be great before the Lord, be filled with the Holy Spirit, and turn many to God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cheating, blaming others, exaggerating, gossiping, breaking promises.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

56. (5 marks)
   Answer: The body is a gift from God, and sexual relations are meant for marriage. Purity keeps us safe and honours God. Children can begin by respecting their bodies, avoiding harmful places and media, obeying parents, praying and saying no to wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for body as gift, 1 for marriage, 1 for honouring God, 1 for respecting body or avoiding harm, 1 for a prayer or obedience.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for your turn, do not fight, do homework first, do not shout, do not copy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Inspired means that God guided the people who wrote the books. What they wrote is His message to people, so the Bible is God's word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God guiding the writers, 1 for the message being God's, 1 for the conclusion that the Bible is God's word.
